source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Description , Power on the system and enter BIOS setup.
Enable the OS Watchdog Timer feature. Save changes and exit. Allow the system to boot.

Note: This bios switch is listed under Integrated Devices.
The user must turn off OS “Automatically restart” option you: Right click My computer (W2K8) or System (Win7), Click on “advanced system settings”, Under the “Startup and Recovery” section click on “settings…”, and under the “System Failure” section there is a check box to disable “automatically Restart” by unchecking it
Input Data
The OS Watchdog Timer field is set to "Enable". POST does not display any error messages

2 Description
Run the utility attached and generate a High IRQ fault.
Input Data
The system should blue screen and reboot in 10 minutes

3 Description
During re-boot POST, see the warning message
Input Data
You should see:
Warning: a fatal error has caused system reset!'
Please check the system event log

4 Description
Enter BIOS setup and disable the OS Watchdog Timer feature. Save changes and exit. Allow the system to boot.
Input Data
The OS Watchdog Timer field is set to "disable". POST does not display any error messages.

5 Description
Run the utility attached and generate a High IRQ fault.
Input Data
The system hangs but does not reboot.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
2. The help text for the Watchdog Timer field should read:
"If your system stops responding, this watchdog timer aids in the recovery of your operating system. When this field is set to Enabled, the operating system is allowed to initialize the timer. When it is set to Disabled (the default), the timer will have no effect on the system."
3. The selections for the field should be "Enabled" and "Disabled".
4. The field should switch to "Disabled" since this is the default setting.
5. Offset 03Ch, bit 0 in the WDAT should be 1 since the Watchdog Timer is enabled in Setup.
6. This time, the table "WDAT" should not exist since the Watchdog Timer is "Disabled" in Setup.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: operator to physically cycle AC + BMC creds to log state
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- AC Cycle 100 times: perform 100 AC power cycles (operator cuts/restores AC at the PSU). Agent logs the host/BMC state across each cycle after the operator drives the physical AC; physical AC cut is human-only.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return per-cycle host boot marker + ipmitool -I lanplus -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" sel elist 2>&1 | tail -30 so the user confirms the SUT boots cleanly after each AC cycle; the AC cycle action is operator-performed.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: 100 AC cycles is long + physical; needs the operator to cut/restore AC and a dedicated SUT.
deepseek_columns.remark: same code in 2 workbook rows (multi-row code)

original_test_intent: The row appears to test OS watchdog recovery from a High IRQ hang, but its acceptance instead defines BIOS help/default and WDAT-table inspection, leaving the canonical scope unresolved.
original_method: Toggle OS Watchdog in BIOS, run a crash utility in enabled/disabled states and observe reboot/hang, while Criteria require low-level WDAT checks.
manual_activity: After correction, an engineer controls BIOS/crash phases and recovery; the agent may collect boot, WDAT, crash and SEL evidence for the selected scope.
required_inputs: Signed/validated High IRQ utility or read-only WDAT method
Enabled/disabled expected state matrix and timing
safety_requirements: Do not substitute AC cycles for watchdog behavior.
Use only a validated fault tool on a dedicated SUT with data protection.
Require console/OOB recovery before inducing a hang.
No automatic retry; preserve crash and first-failure logs.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, automate permitted read-only WDAT/event collection and time the approved fault phases.
Do not induce an ambiguous crash or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Select/align scope and approve crash utility/recovery.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: 100 AC cycles are unrelated and rejected; embedded credentials also violate safety practice.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No executable recommendation until the owner chooses fault-recovery versus WDAT-table scope.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All BIOS states, 10-minute reboot, warning, hang, WDAT criteria and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Split into a watchdog fault-recovery case and a BIOS/WDAT configuration case, or align one canonical state matrix with a validated tool and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, OS, ACPI/WDAT and tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates mixed crash and table-only acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents one evidence class from passing an untested scope.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fault injection can hang or corrupt an active system.

project_override_considerations: A project may split the scopes, but each result must identify which source obligations were executed.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items say loader Watchdog; Procedure executes OS-watchdog High IRQ recovery; Criteria only judge BIOS help/default and WDAT presence/bit. Code is reused at row 1525 for unrelated AC cycling.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The fault behavior and WDAT inspection are different core operations; choosing either by inference could induce an unnecessary crash and still not satisfy the other acceptance.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines a split/align resolution and crash evidence boundary.

review_improvement: Prevents destructive watchdog fault injection until the watchdog layer and state-specific evidence agree.
independent_technical_reasoning: A WDAT table bit proves firmware exposure, while reboot-versus-hang proves runtime servicing and expiration; neither automatically proves the other, so the mixed source cannot be safely executed as one case.
